item.title: Eurobites: Open Cosmos lands Liechtenstein satellite spectrum
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: UK government drops mandatory digital ID scheme; AccelerComm supplies PHY tech to space connectivity program; game on for stadium upgrades.

item.title: The Divide: What's up with BEAD non-deployment funds?
item.description: This week: Missouri State Rep. Louis Riggs and Benton's Drew Garner join the podcast to discuss the state of the BEAD program and their push to get the NTIA to 'follow the law' and release full funding to the states.

item.title: Dish contracts snare spotlight in EchoStar-SpaceX deal review
item.description: Several orgs, fiber vendors and other contractors want Dish Wireless to honor its financial obligations as a condition of the EchoStar-SpaceX spectrum deal. EchoStar says it's inappropriate for the FCC to step into private disputes.

item.title: FWA CPE and infrastructure spending to exceed $10B through 2029 – Dell'Oro
item.description: Dell'Oro expects total FWA revenues, including RAN equipment, residential CPE and enterprise and router gateway to grow 10% in 2025 and continue to rise through 2029. #pressrelease

item.title: Apple leads global smartphone growth in Q4 2025 – Omdia
item.description: The global smartphone market rose 5% in the fourth quarter of 2025, despite rising costs that weighed on vendors, according to Omdia. Apple led the way with 25% market share. #pressrelease

item.title: Comcast upgrades broadband in Massachusetts public housing
item.description: Comcast upgrades are part of the first round of funding in the Massachusetts Residential Retrofit Program, providing access to high-speed, symmetrical broadband for residents of public and affordable housing. #pressrelease

item.title: Verizon can lock phones to network for longer
item.description: FCC removes requirement for Verizon to unlock phones after 60 days, marking a regulatory win for the carrier with implications for reducing costs and churn. But cable operators want new unlocking rules.

item.title: California officials 'sympathetic' to Verizon's deployment plight – Levin
item.description: Deployment commitments have emerged as a sticking point in California's review of the Verizon-Frontier deal, but commissioners appear to be 'sympathetic' to Verizon's side of the argument, says New Street's Blair Levin.

item.title: Boingo Wireless selected as cellular infrastructure and Wi-Fi provider for the New York Mets and Citi Field
item.description: Boingo's converged, neutral host network supports both cellular and Wi-Fi connections, including 5G service for all Tier One carriers. #pressrelease

item.title: Array completes spectrum sale to AT&T for $1B
item.description: Array Digital Infrastructure, formerly US Cellular, closes transaction to sell 700MHz and 3.45GHz spectrum assets to AT&T for $1 billion in a deal announced in November 2024. #pressrelease
